other_failure_modes.name: Validation Leakage in Ensembling
other_failure_modes.description: The agent optimizes ensemble combination weights using the same validation set that was used for early stopping and hyperparameter tuning of the base models. This causes the ensemble weights to overfit to the optimistically biased validation predictions. A separate holdout set or out-of-fold cross-validation predictions should be used to fit the meta-learner/ensemble.

summary: The agent provides a robust and well-structured tabular regression pipeline, featuring comprehensive feature engineering, deep learning integration, and proper data splitting. However, it suffers from a single-split evaluation methodology and leaks validation data into the ensemble weight optimization by reusing the early-stopping validation set.
